get_all_states_game_tree: get all states from a pyspiel game tree as a dictionary indexed by string representation
get_all_states_with_depth_limit: get all states from a game tree up to a specified depth limit for bounded traversal
get_all_states_include_chance: get all states from a game including chance node states for complete game exploration
get_all_states_handle_cycles: get all states from a cyclic game by stopping recursion when states are encountered again
get_all_states_simultaneous: get all states from a game with simultaneous move nodes using joint action enumeration
